signal: Daxko declared an AI-first strategy and acquired Exercise.com and VFPnext, expanding its fitness software footprint heading into 2026.

email.body1:
Kaylin, saw Daxko go AI-first and pull in Exercise.com and VFPnext to broaden the fitness portfolio.

Acquisitions like those throw off a wave of cross-sell and expansion signals, but most sales ops teams cannot route them to action fast enough before they go cold. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach autonomously, 3-5x more meetings per rep without new headcount.

I built a signal play for Daxko off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kaylin, quick follow-up for Daxko.

Integrating new customer bases usually buries signals that should trigger outreach, and the latency between signal and action is where measurable lift hides. Closing it is one of the fastest ways to move reply rates.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Kaylin, last bit of proof for Daxko.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Daxko reply rate likely compares to other fitness-software vendors. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kaylin, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If turning signals into pipeline faster is not on the sales ops roadmap this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating acquisitions is its own kind of busy and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Daxko either way.
